definitions.explanation: A party held at the end of the year, typically in December, where coworkers, friends, or club members gather to celebrate and forget the troubles of the past year. Literally 'forget the year gathering.' A deeply ingrained custom in Japanese workplace and social culture.

⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{金曜日|きんようび}→金曜日：00642_kinyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
{忘年会|ぼうねんかい} season runs from late November through December. Workplaces, clubs, and friend groups each hold their own parties, so people may attend several during the season. The word literally means 'forget-year-gathering' ({忘|ぼう} forget + ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ year + ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ gathering).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {忘年会|ぼうねんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (hold a year-end party)
- {忘年会|ぼうねんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧ (attend a year-end party)
- {忘年会|ぼうねんかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{幹事|かんじ}→幹事：16378_kanji⟧ (organizer of the year-end party)
- {忘年会|ぼうねんかい}⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧ (year-end party season)
